$meta.description: A `MetaMail` object can be obtained by using [mail_login](#GENERAL_MAIL_LOGIN). The `classID` used for this object is `"MetaMail"`.

delete.description: Deletes every matching ID in a `list` of mail ID strings. Returns one if at least one mail was deleted and `null` if none matched or the list is invalid. The account is refreshed first; refresh failures return `"MetaMail: Unable to refresh mail account."`. Every mail method enforces a two-second cooldown after the previous mail use and returns `"MetaMail: Wait 2 seconds before using mail again."` when called too soon.

fetch.description: Returns a `list` of mail summaries containing ID, sender, subject, and a 125-character preview. The account is refreshed before reading; refresh failures return `"MetaMail: Unable to refresh mail account."`. Every mail method enforces a two-second cooldown after the previous mail use and returns `"MetaMail: Wait 2 seconds before using mail again."` when called too soon.

read.description: Takes a `list` of mail ID strings and returns a `list` of full-message strings in the same order, using `"Mail not found"` for each missing ID. A non-list argument or non-string element returns `null`. The account is refreshed first; refresh failures return `"MetaMail: Unable to refresh mail account."`. Every mail method enforces a two-second cooldown after the previous mail use and returns `"MetaMail: Wait 2 seconds before using mail again."` when called too soon.

send.description: Sends mail from the account represented by this `MetaMail` object. Subject and message limits are 128 and 2500 characters. Returns one on success or an error `string`; account access failures return `"send: Unable to access mail account."`. Every mail method enforces a two-second cooldown after the previous mail use and returns `"MetaMail: Wait 2 seconds before using mail again."` when called too soon.
example: print("There was an error while sending mail: " + result)

delete_all.description: Deletes every mail in the account and returns one. The account is refreshed first; refresh failures return `"MetaMail: Unable to refresh mail account."`. Missing internet returns `"delete_all: No internet access."`. Every mail method enforces a two-second cooldown after the previous mail use and returns `"MetaMail: Wait 2 seconds before using mail again."` when called too soon.
